verdict.rationale: Otter documents solid capture breadth: scheduled bot-based joining across Zoom/Teams/Meet (otter-docs-17), plus bot-free desktop and Meet capture for users who don't want a bot present (otter-docs-2, otter-docs-15, otter-docs-38). But hands-on/community reports concretely contradict the 'recording where I want it' promise — users found the bot joining confidential calls unexpectedly, being unable to identify who invited it, and the bot rejoining despite attempts to remove it (otter-comm-8, otter-comm-6, otter-comm-7, otter-comm-5), undermining reliable, controlled capture. missing for 10: independent verification of accurate/controllable scheduling behavior, resolution of the 'can't stop the bot' complaints, and confirmation that bot-free recording is equally reliable across all three platforms.
